title: Frugal: Efficient and Economic Embedding Model Training with Commodity GPUs
problem: Embedding model training on commodity GPUs (those lacking high-bandwidth inter-GPU interconnects and PCIe peer-to-peer support) suffers poor performance due to communication bottlenecks: sparse embedding lookups generate irregular, small-sized all-to-all communication that overwhelms limited commodity GPU network bandwidth. This makes cost-effective training on low-end GPU clusters impractical despite their cheap compute for the memory-intensive embedding workload.
motivation: Commodity GPUs offer cost-efficient computing power ideally matched to embedding models' low compute demands, but the communication deficiency of commodity interconnects (no NVLink, no PCIe P2P) creates a prohibitive performance gap relative to high-end clusters.
method: Frugal addresses communication bottlenecks through a combination of: (1) communication-aware embedding table partitioning that minimizes cross-GPU sparse lookup traffic, (2) compression or aggregation of embedding gradients to reduce bandwidth demand over commodity interconnects, and (3) scheduling that overlaps compute and communication phases to hide latency. The system is designed for the constraint of no PCIe P2P, routing communication through CPU host memory when necessary.
key_novelty: A system co-design of embedding-table partitioning, gradient communication optimization, and compute-communication overlap tailored to the specific communication deficiencies of commodity GPU clusters.
contributions: Communication-aware embedding table partitioning minimizing cross-GPU sparse lookup traffic on commodity GPUs
Gradient communication optimization adapted to low-bandwidth commodity interconnects without PCIe P2P
Compute-communication overlap scheduling for embedding model training
Efficient and economical embedding training demonstrated on commodity GPU clusters

metrics.speedup: improved training throughput on commodity GPUs (specific numbers not in abstract)
metrics.other: cost efficiency on commodity GPU clusters vs. high-end clusters

baselines: direct embedding training on commodity GPUs without optimization
limitations: Specific speedup numbers and the commodity GPU hardware configurations tested are not stated in the abstract.
primary_theme: communication-efficient embedding training on commodity GPU clusters
